## What to do now (open enrollment)

- Enroll by **December 15, 2026** for coverage starting January 1, 2027. Open enrollment ends **January 15, 2027**.
- Log in to Pennie, update your income and household, and compare plans even if you like yours.
- Free help: Pennie 1-844-844-8040; PHLP helpline 1-800-274-3258; PID complaints 1-866-722-6675.
